appDesc.message: Translate text just by hovering over it. Includes an on-device engine that works offline with no API keys and no rate limits.

optionsDesc.message: Configure your translation preferences and modifiers.

modifierHint.message: Hold this key while hovering over text to translate.

autoReverseHint.message: Automatically translate back to an alternative language if reading text natively in your Target Language.

browserHint.message: Translation runs entirely on your device: no API keys, no rate limits, and it works offline. Language packs download by themselves the first time you hover, so this section is only needed to prepare one in advance.

nativeReady.message: Ready. This pair is installed and works offline.

nativeDownloadable.message: Supported, but the language pack is not installed yet.

nativeSamePair.message: Source and target are the same language.

nativeUnavailablePair.message: This language pair is not supported on-device.

nativeUnsupported.message: Not available in this browser. Requires Chrome 138+ or Edge 148+ on desktop.

errorNativeUnsupported.message: On-device translation requires Chrome 138+ or Edge 148+ on desktop.

errorNativePair.message: This language pair is not supported on-device.

errorNativeDownload.message: This language pack is not installed yet.

errorNativeSource.message: Could not detect the source language of this text.

errorGoogleRateLimit.message: Google hit its rate limit (429). Switch to the Browser engine in the options for unlimited translations.

nativeRetryHint.message: The browser is still setting up its translation engine. Wait a minute and try again.

browserOpenTabBtn.message: Open in a tab to download

nativeNeedsTab.message: The language pack must be downloaded from a full tab: this popup closes as soon as it loses focus.

nativeTimeout.message: The download did not respond. Check your connection and try again.

tooltipOneTime.message: One-time download, then it works offline

errorNativeDownloadFailed.message: The language pack could not be downloaded.
